frequency_question: How often do nominated agency heads secure Senate confirmation when backed by the executive within a calendar year?
membership_rule: Includes all formally submitted cabinet and statutory agency head nominations requiring Senate confirmation. Excludes withdrawn nominations where executive support was explicitly pulled due to internal scandal prior to committee consideration.
coverage_note: 6 named prominent health/science related civilian nominations; believed roughly 8 total major health/transport equivalent ones in same timeframe.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-cabinet positions with less intense executive capital deployed.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to the current executive administration's tenure and Senate confirmation dynamics.
